gloss: newcomer award; rookie of the year award

definitions.gloss: newcomer award; best new talent award; rookie of the year
definitions.explanation: An award given to a promising newcomer in a field such as literature, music, film, or sports.

examples.japanese: {新人賞|しんじんしょう}に{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: I was selected for the newcomer award.

examples.japanese: デビュー{作|さく}で{新人賞|しんじんしょう}を{受賞|じゅしょう}した。
examples.english: She won the newcomer award with her debut work.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{多|おお}くの{若|わか}い{作家|さっか}が{新人賞|しんじんしょう}に{応募|おうぼ}するが、{受賞|じゅしょう}できるのはほんの{一握|ひとにぎ}りだ。
examples.english: Every year many young writers apply for the newcomer award, but only a handful win.

notes:
Composed of {新人|しんじん} (newcomer, rookie) + {賞|しょう} (prize, award). These awards exist across many fields — literature, music, film, comedy, and sports. They serve as important career launches for new talent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新人賞|しんじんしょう}を{受賞|じゅしょう}する: to win a newcomer award
- {新人賞|しんじんしょう}に{応募|おうぼ}する: to apply for a newcomer award
- {新人賞|しんじんしょう}の{最終|さいしゅう}{選考|せんこう}: final selection for a newcomer award
- {新人賞|しんじんしょう}{受賞者|じゅしょうしゃ}: newcomer award winner

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {文学賞|ぶんがくしょう}: literary prize — a broader category; {新人賞|しんじんしょう} is specifically for newcomers
- {大賞|たいしょう}: grand prize — the top award in a competition
- {最優秀賞|さいゆうしゅうしょう}: best award — given for the highest overall quality
